max_notifications.label: Notifications shown in the action center

action.label: Hover action
action.description: Runs when the pointer rests on the zone: a noctalia msg command such as "panel-open control-center", or "exec <shell command>".

length.label: Length
length.description: Size of the hover strip along the bar, in pixels.

delay_ms.label: Hover delay
delay_ms.description: How long the pointer must rest on the zone before the action runs, in milliseconds.
